note: The seven-step setup table (kernel-rpc.md §14.4). Both the onboarding extension and the kernel read this file; order, available actions, rejection lines and next-step lines are written here once and derived everywhere else. `needs` are step ids; a step whose `only_for` names a source kind counts as satisfied for the other kind. `kind` is ask (the model asks the player), external (the host does something outside the kernel) or op (a method named by `op`; `side` is kernel unless the op is the module extension's own driver loop, §14.5).

zh-Hans.unknown_step: 没有叫 {step} 的步骤。可用的步骤：{available}。下一步：{next}
zh-Hans.needs_unmet: {step} 还不能做：先完成 {missing}。下一步：{next}
zh-Hans.already_done: {step} 已经完成（回执 {receipt}），不重复。下一步：{next}
zh-Hans.all_done: 建卡已完成，战役已就绪。开桌：{launch}

en.unknown_step: There is no step named {step}. Available steps: {available}. Next: {next}
en.needs_unmet: {step} is not available yet: finish {missing} first. Next: {next}
en.already_done: {step} is already done (receipt {receipt}); it is not repeated. Next: {next}
en.all_done: Setup is complete and the campaign is ready. Open the table: {launch}

params.starter: one of campaign.list's starter names (kernel.hello content.modules)
params.bundle: a directory path holding a coc.pdf-bundle.v1 manifest

zh-Hans.do: 让玩家选一个 starter（kernel.hello 给的名单）或给一个资料包目录。
zh-Hans.next: 选来源：说出一个 starter 的名字，或给出资料包目录。

en.do: Ask the player to pick a starter (the list from kernel.hello) or to give a bundle directory.
en.next: Choose the source: name a starter, or give a bundle directory.

zh-Hans.do: 资料包不存在时告诉玩家怎么用宿主的 PDF 技能产出它，然后等；存在则直接过。
zh-Hans.next: 确认资料包目录已经存在（宿主的 PDF 技能产出 manifest.json 与 pages/）。

en.do: If the bundle does not exist, tell the player how to produce it with the host's PDF skill and wait; if it exists, pass.
en.next: Confirm the bundle directory exists (the host's PDF skill writes manifest.json and pages/).

params.module: starter id, or the module id the bundle will bind to
params.title: optional

zh-Hans.do: campaign.create：status 为 setting_up；starter 时同时把模组登记进存储。
zh-Hans.next: 建战役：给一个战役 id（和标题，可省略）。

en.do: campaign.create: status setting_up; a starter is registered into the module store at the same time.
en.next: Create the campaign: give a campaign id (and an optional title).

params.module_id: optional override of the manifest slug

zh-Hans.do: module.bind 校验资料包并登记，再 module.plan 切 section。

en.do: module.bind validates and registers the bundle, then module.plan cuts sections.
en.next: Bind the bundle: module.bind, then module.plan.

zh-Hans.do: 起构建（module 扩展驱动），等到 opening_ready。
zh-Hans.next: 构建开场：module.build，直到 module.status 报 opening_ready。

en.do: Start the build (driven by the module extension) and wait for opening_ready.
en.next: Build the opening: module.build until module.status reports opening_ready.

params.name: as the player said it, stored verbatim
params.occupation: an id from setup.occupations (the model maps the player's concept to it)
params.concept: optional, the player's one line, stored verbatim
params.seed: optional; rolled characteristics are reproducible from it
params.era: optional override of the module's era for the skill sheet and finance tables

defaults.source_note: Chargen defaults are setup policy, not rulebook numbers: 27 sits in the 20-39 bracket (one EDU improvement check, no reductions) and quick_fire needs no dice.

formulas.source_note: Keeper Rulebook Chapter 3, personal interest skill points = INT x 2 (investigator-create-contract.json skill_budget description).

interest_pool.source_note: Keeper Rulebook Chapter 3: no points may be put into Cthulhu Mythos at creation; Credit Rating is set from the occupation's range.

zh-Hans.do: 只问名字与职业概念；用 setup.occupations 把概念落到职业 id；数值由内核推导。
zh-Hans.next: 建卡：告诉我调查员的名字和你想玩的职业概念。

en.do: Ask only for a name and an occupation concept; map the concept to an occupation id with setup.occupations; the kernel derives every number.
en.next: Create the investigator: tell me the name and the kind of person you want to play.

zh-Hans.do: setup.complete：写 setup_handoff 收据，战役进 ready_for_table，进程退出并打印开桌命令。
zh-Hans.next: 收尾：确认无误后完成建卡。

en.do: setup.complete: write the setup_handoff receipt, move the campaign to ready_for_table, exit and print the launch line.
